Subject: Runway triage — QBR prep kickoff

Team —

Quick kickoff for the QBR runway triage we discussed in leadership. Agenda:
- One-line status for top 8 deals (confidence / blockers)
- Any forecast deltas we should bake into the QBR narrative
- Ownership for account one-pagers and ask of customer (MVP M.A.P. items)

Please reply with two things by EOD tomorrow:
1) Short status row for any accounts you own in the attached runway matrix (confidence 1-5, blockers)
2) One owner for the account one-pager (deck slide)

I attached a blank runway matrix — fill the yellow columns. I will consolidate on Wednesday and push a single slide pack for exec review.

Tessa
Tessa Morgan
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Tessa — thanks, starting to pull our book. Initial notes below for top accounts I own:

- BlueCloud (RF-2389): Confidence 3/5 — procurement timeline slipped; POC performed but legal still reviewing data handling (need SOC 2 evidence). Asking Markus to own the M.A.P. with BlueCloud.
- Meridian Health: Confidence 4/5 — exec sponsor confirmed; final PO expected next week.
- Vertex Retail: Confidence 2/5 — stuck on integration timeline and sample throughput.

Plan: I will complete the matrix by EOD tomorrow and draft the one-pager for BlueCloud. Will attach initial M.A.P. notes.

Forwarding ask to Sara (BlueCloud) for one missing artifact (SOC 2 evidence template) in a follow-up if that's ok.

-Mateo

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2027 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Runway triage — QBR prep kickoff

Copy — I looked at the BlueCloud economics and there are a couple of levers we can use if we need to protect the forecast without materially changing unit economics:
- Offer a short-term pilot discount (4 weeks) tied to volume thresholds (keeps ACV intact if conversion happens)
- Reserve an additional dedicated slot for their production cutover to preserve latency SLOs

If we need to surface this in the QBR narrative, I recommend we mark BlueCloud as "contingent — mitigation defined" and call out the pilot discount as the primary mitigation. I can draft the short clause for the M.A.P. and run it past Legal.

-Priyom
Director, Revenue Ops
Redwood Inference

Best,
